slides.title: Tripwire / Driftwire
slides.notes: Pinned source; isolated tests and detailed limits in TESTS.md. No hosted demo or official score.

slides.title: 1 · Insufficient samples are checked after the unaffected branch
slides.fix: Evaluate insufficiency before the unaffected return, or return separate compatibility and adequacy results with an explicit trusted-baseline requirement.
slides.notes: Direct helper reproduction returned Ready for an unmoved Movement with insufficient=True. Positive controls return Insufficient Evidence when affected=True and Blocked for unexplained movement. The first full API tiny-fixture control returned Blocked (A1 Blocked, A2 Ready), so this result proves the helper precedence defect, not that every small cohort escapes the outer guards.

slides.title: 2 · A flagged finding without a repair appears fully decided
slides.fix: Require an explicit finding-level disposition when no repair exists, and distinguish request_more_evidence from approval to proceed.
slides.notes: Direct review_status calls returned an empty open list for a flagged finding without repairs and for a repair marked request_more_evidence. These are helper-level reproductions with invented review documents; no UI bypass was tested.

slides.title: 3 · Analysis rounding precedes effect classification
slides.fix: Keep full-precision calculation fields and format separate display values.
slides.notes: A1 returns means and differences rounded to three decimals before movement is computed. Small changes and near-zero effects can be hidden or disproportionately changed by display precision. This is not evidence that the published practice result is wrong. Acceptance: Probe near-zero values and changes on each side of the tolerance at full precision; ensure changing display precision cannot change the verdict.

slides.title: 4 · New review calls replace prior decisions
slides.notes: apply_decisions creates a new decisions list from the supplied mapping and replaces the previous list. The helper records neither decision time nor a stable reviewer identity. This is suitable for a current-state document, but is not an immutable approval history. Acceptance: Approve, revise, and request evidence on the same repair. Export the complete history without changing the original evidence.

slides.title: 5 · The no-AI statement is broader than the repository
slides.fix: Scope the claim to the deterministic core and explain the optional intake route, transmitted metadata, and opt-in control.
slides.notes: The README says there are no AI features or AI-service calls, while the optional intake prototype implements consent-gated OpenAI mapping suggestions. The consent gate is a positive control; its presence makes the blanket claim inaccurate. No network call was made in this review. Acceptance: Documentation and UI agree about which route sends information; a no-consent test verifies no request occurs.

slides.title: What is verified so far
slides.fix: Read TESTS.md for skips, positive controls and limits.
slides.notes: 399 passed, 6 skipped, 0 failed, 0 errors; independent safeguards are targeted probes, not a score.
